model.description: A trained predictive model: everything needed to apply it, plus the training summary shown in the catalog

tags.description: Comma-separated tags, shown in the catalog and the model's Details

engine_name.description: Method id: the mlname meta of its functions

engine_namespace.description: Package of the method's train function, or the namespace of a script method

options.description: Preparation replay; keys compatible with the old models: preprocessingInfo, postprocessingInfo, positiveClass, negativeClass, binaryClassificationThreshold, targetType, allowNulls. missingValues: {mode, neighbors?, distance?, skippedRows}; the preprocessingInfo ids ignore-missing and impute-missing record the missing-value handling and are not replayed. skippedColumns: [names] records the columns Skip unique categories left out (replayed by name). oneHotCategories: {<column>: [categories]} records the training categories of one-hot (replayed). postprocessingInfo ids: binary-classification (models of the former regression mode: the raw score cut at binaryClassificationThreshold), class-probabilities (Predict probability: labels from the method's class probabilities - two classes: positiveClass when its probability reaches binaryClassificationThreshold (thresholdMetric: the metric it maximizes), else negativeClass; more classes: the most probable one - and the probability columns are added when applied)

metrics.description: {train: {<metric id>: number}, validation: {<metric id>: number}, test?: {<metric id>: number} (the final model on the rows held out before a search), positiveClass?, classes?: [{label, rows, train: {<class metric id>: number}, validation: {...}}]}; ids: mse, rmse, mae, r2, accuracy, f1, sensitivity, specificity, precision, npv, auc, balancedAccuracy, mcc, averagePrecision, logLoss, brier (logLoss and brier computed by Forge from the class probabilities; auc and averagePrecision for classifiers whose method returns class probabilities (of the scores for a model of the former binary-classification mode); balancedAccuracy and mcc computed by Forge from the labels; auc (when the report exists), averagePrecision and classes from Crux through Eda:classificationReport); class metric ids: precision, sensitivity, f1, auc, averagePrecision

splitting.description: {scheme: kfold, folds, isStratified, isShuffled} or {scheme: holdout, trainFraction, isStratified, isShuffled}; a missing isShuffled (older models) means shuffled

search.description: The search that chose the method and settings (Tune or Find best model): {mode: tune|best, metric, budgetSeconds?, maxTrials? (the limit; a continued one sums its runs'), strategy?: equal|halving (best), seed, trials, completed, pruned, failed, elapsedMs, stopped: budget|cancelled|exhausted|trials|failed, holdOut?: {rows, fraction}, test?: auto|off|<fraction>, space?: {searched: [{name, type: int|float|categorical, low?, high?, log?, step?, choices?, simpler?}], pinned: [names]} (Tune), methods?: [{method, trials, outcome: complete|failed|abandoned|unstarted, note?, eliminatedRound?}] (best: every method tried, in cost order; eliminatedRound: the halving round it was dropped after, from 0), leaders: [{method, hyperparameters, score, se, foldScores, trials, chosen, note?}]}; score is the metric by the chosen validation on the search rows, chosen marks the pick: Tune's by the one-standard-error rule, Find's the best score - se (score + se if minimized)

storage_mode.description: What the model keeps of its training data: none (a summary), reference (a link to the source), copy (an uploaded table)

dataset_ref.description: reference mode: {kind: file|query|script, script, path?, id?, name?}; script is the creation script the platform recorded for the table, one call per line, or an OpenFile call of the table's server file when the platform recorded only that

dataset_table_id.description: copy mode: id of the training table uploaded when the model is saved (the feature and target columns), deleted with the model; no foreign key

dataset_fingerprint.description: {rowCount, columnCount, hash, columns: [{name, type, missingCount, min?, max?, mean?, categories?}]}

has_training_rows.description: The model file embeds training rows (SVM support vectors); from the method's meta.mlhasrows

legacy_id.description: Id of the migrated core model

training_run.description: One completed, failed or cancelled training (a training superseded by a newer one is not recorded), saved as a model or not

application.description: One application of a model to a table: who, when, how many rows, the prediction column and the outcome; secured by the model

skipped_rows.description: Rows left without a prediction because of missing values
